ExecuteCodeAction.description:
Execute code in a specific programming language within an existing session. Use this for running Python
scripts, JavaScript/TypeScript code, data analysis, calculations, or any programming task. The session maintains
state between executions.

type.description: Execute code in the code interpreter
type.title: Type

session_name.description: Session name. If not provided, uses the default session which will be auto-created if needed.
session_name.title: Session Name

clear_context.description: Whether to clear the execution context before running code
clear_context.title: Clear Context

ExecuteCodeAction.title: ExecuteCodeAction

ExecuteCommandAction.description:
Execute shell/terminal commands within the sandbox environment. Use this for system operations like installing
packages, running scripts, file management, or any command-line tasks that need to be performed in the session.

type.description: Execute a shell command in the code interpreter
type.title: Type

session_name.description: Session name. If not provided, uses the default session.
session_name.title: Session Name

ExecuteCommandAction.title: ExecuteCommandAction

FileContent.description:
Represents a file with its path and text content for writing to the sandbox file system. Used when creating or
updating files during code execution sessions.

path.description: The file path where content should be written
path.title: Path

blob.description: Base64-encoded binary content for the file
blob.title: Blob

FileContent.title: FileContent

InitSessionAction.description:
Create a new isolated code execution environment. Use this when starting a new coding task, data analysis
project, or when you need a fresh sandbox environment. Each session maintains its own state, variables,
and file system.

type.description: Initialize a new code interpreter session
type.title: Type

description.description: Required description of what this session will be used for
description.title: Description

session_name.description: Session name. If not provided, a default session will be used.
session_name.title: Session Name

InitSessionAction.title: InitSessionAction

LanguageType.description: Supported programming languages for code execution.
LanguageType.title: LanguageType

ListFilesAction.description:
Browse and list files and directories within the sandbox file system. Use this to explore the directory
structure, find files, or understand what's available in the session before reading or manipulating files.

session_name.description: Session name. If not provided, uses the default session.
session_name.title: Session Name

path.description: Directory path to list (defaults to current directory)
path.title: Path

ListFilesAction.title: ListFilesAction

ListLocalSessionsAction.description:
View all active code interpreter sessions managed by this tool instance. Use this to see what sessions are
available, check their status, or find the session name you need for other operations.

type.description: List all local sessions managed by this tool instance
type.title: Type

ListLocalSessionsAction.title: ListLocalSessionsAction

ReadFilesAction.description:
Read the contents of one or more files from the sandbox file system. Use this to examine data files,
configuration files, code files, or any other files that have been created or uploaded to the session.

type.description: Read files from the code interpreter
type.title: Type

session_name.description: Session name. If not provided, uses the default session.
session_name.title: Session Name

paths.description: List of file paths to read
paths.title: Paths

ReadFilesAction.title: ReadFilesAction

RemoveFilesAction.description:
Delete one or more files from the sandbox file system. Use this to clean up temporary files, remove outdated
data, or manage storage space within the session. Be careful as this permanently removes files.

type.description: Remove files from the code interpreter
type.title: Type

session_name.description: Session name. If not provided, uses the default session.
session_name.title: Session Name

paths.description: Required list of file paths to remove
paths.title: Paths

RemoveFilesAction.title: RemoveFilesAction

WriteFilesAction.description:
Create or update multiple files in the sandbox file system with specified content. Use this to save data,
create configuration files, write code files, or store any text-based content that your code execution will need.

type.description: Write files to the code interpreter
type.title: Type

session_name.description: Session name. If not provided, uses the default session.
session_name.title: Session Name

content.description: Required list of file content to write
content.title: Content

WriteFilesAction.title: WriteFilesAction
